recognize_zh: E-cadherin 免疫染色中，只有少數散在、體積很大的細胞呈棕色膜狀陽性，細胞核圓且大、染色質淡；背景骨髓細胞很少且沒有成群的正常紅血球前驅細胞。這符合 parvovirus B19 造成純紅血球再生不良時的巨大原紅血球（giant proerythroblast）。
features: Scattered, isolated very large cells (several times the size of surrounding nuclei) with membranous/cytoplasmic E-cadherin positivity
Large round to oval nuclei with pale, open chromatin inside a rim of positive cytoplasm
Absence of clusters of smaller E-cadherin-positive maturing erythroid precursors
Hypocellular background composed mainly of granulocytic nuclei, stromal cells and abundant fat spaces
E-cadherin marks early erythroid precursors, confirming the erythroid lineage of the giant cells
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section stained for E-cadherin by immunohistochemistry shows a hypocellular marrow with prominent fat and a residual population of granulocytic and stromal cells. Scattered single very large cells with large round nuclei and open chromatin show membranous and cytoplasmic E-cadherin staining, identifying them as early erythroid precursors. Normal erythroid islands composed of smaller, maturing E-cadherin-positive precursors are absent. Findings are consistent with giant proerythroblasts of parvovirus B19 infection with pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are E-cadherin negative and CD61/CD42b positive, with lobulated rather than round single nuclei.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of E-cadherin-positive immature erythroid cells (often p53-positive) rather than rare isolated giant proerythroblasts in a hypocellular marrow.
Carcinoma cells are also E-cadherin positive but form cohesive clusters and are keratin positive, whereas proerythroblasts are keratin negative and CD71/glycophorin positive.
Megaloblastic anemia shows increased, maturing erythroid precursors at all stages rather than absent maturation with only isolated giant pronormoblasts.
